name: vaulta-mark
description: Password-encrypted bookmarks kept out of Chrome's bookmarks and omnibox. Opens in incognito. Optional sync via your own Google Drive.
author: zyndata

scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run type-check && npm run test && npm run build && npm run verify:invariants

//dependencies: Deliberately empty and staying that way (PLAN.md D4) — everything the extension needs is in the platform. A runtime dependency needs a written case and a bundle measurement. Dev dependencies are unrestricted.
